newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD GO TOP AFTER BEATING FORTUNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD GO TOP AFTER BEATING FORTUNA.

text.p: Feyenoord Rotterdam completed their third consecutive victory by beating Fortuna Sittard 2-0 away on Tuesday to go top of the Dutch first division.
A sixth minute goal by Swedish international Henke Larsson and a spot kick converted by Ronald Koeman took Feyenoord one point clear of second-placed PSV Eindhoven, who have a game in hand.

Koeman was returning after a three-match suspension for a red card received at the end of last season. He scored from the penalty spot after winger Gaston Taument was brought down by midfielder Robert Loontjens.
After Larsson's early goal gave Feyenoord the initiative they had little trouble in controlling the match.
PSV can regain the lead on Thursday when they are at home to RKC Waalwijk.
